title: Novikov Conjecture
exact_target: Are all higher signatures, obtained by pairing the manifold’s L-class with classes from a group classifying space, preserved by orientation-preserving homotopy equivalences?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1334 (TOP-004). CC BY 4.0.
